summary: Petrobras filed a routine Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K furnished to the SEC) announcing a third oil discovery in block FZA-M-59 in ultra-deep waters off Amapá at 2,886 meters water depth, following prior notices dated August 14 and October 22, 2026. Drilling and geological data acquisition are complete; only well abandonment remains before the rig moves to the Potiguar Basin for the Mão de Ouro location. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, pricing, or deal mechanics are disclosed. No special-situation angle; operational exploration update only.
